{{Top}} {{Structure |image= |name=Yaga Minor shipyards |constructed= |destroyed= |type= |location=[[Yaga Minor/Legends|Yaga Minor]] |interest= |rebuilt= |builder=[[Yaga (species)|Yagai]] |height= |width= |affiliation= *[[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]][[Outbound Flight (novel)|''Outbound Flight'']] *[[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]]''[[The Last Command]]'' *[[Thrawn's confederation]] *[[Imperial Remnant/Legends|Imperial Remnant]]''[[Vision of the Future]]'' *[[Galactic Federation of Free Alliances]]''[[The New Jedi Order: Force Heretic I: Remnant]]'' *[[Fel Empire]]''[[The Essential Atlas]]'' *[[Empire-in-exile]] }} {{Quote|We're down to a single major shipyard and it can't keep up with demand for capital ships.|[[Admiral/Legends|Admiral]] [[Gilad Pellaeon/Legends|Gilad Pellaeon]] to [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Ardiff]]|''[[Specter of the Past]]''}} The '''Yaga Minor shipyards''' were the [[The galaxy/Legends|galaxy]] renowned [[Shipyard/Legends|ship building facilities]] of [[Yaga Minor/Legends|Yaga Minor]]. ==History== {{Quote|Look at all that new construction. They aren't kidding around, are they?''"
"''No, they're not. Nor are they kidding around at Ord Trasi or Yaga Minor.|[[Dankin]] and [[Talon Karrde]], about the [[Bilbringi Shipyards]]|}} During the reign of [[Grand Admiral/Legends|Grand Admiral]] [[Mitth'raw'nuruodo/Legends|Thrawn]], the shipyards were fully under his control, under his orders, the shipyards were to begin production of [[Imperial-class Star Destroyer/Legends|''Imperial''-class Star Destroyers]]. By the signing of the [[Pellaeon–Gavrisom Treaty|Bastion Accords]], the Yaga Minor shipyards were the [[Imperial Remnant/Legends|Imperial Remnant's]] last [[Shipyard/Legends|shipyard]]. During the [[Yuuzhan Vong War]], the shipyards were [[Infiltration of the Yaga Minor shipyards|infiltrated]] by a group of [[Yuuzhan Vong]] [[Saboteur/Legends|saboteurs]], as well as the [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lady]] [[Lumiya]].{{GamerCite|8|I, Yuuzhan Vong}} They were later also affiliated with the [[Galactic Federation of Free Alliances]]. They would eventually be under the control of the [[Fel Empire]], and later [[Empire-in-exile]]. {{Struct-stub}} ==Appearances== *[[Star Wars: Rebellion (video game)|''Star Wars: Rebellion'']] {{Mo}} *''[[The Last Command]]'' {{Ab|The Last Command (unabridged audiobook)}} *''[[Specter of the Past]]'' {{Ab|Specter of the Past (unabridged audiobook)}} {{Imo}} *''[[Vision of the Future]]'' {{Ab|Vision of the Future (unabridged audiobook)}} *''[[The New Jedi Order: Force Heretic I: Remnant]]'' *[[Millennium Falcon (novel)|''Millennium Falcon'']] {{Ab|Millennium Falcon (audiobook)}} {{Mo}} ==Sources== *''[[The Last Command Sourcebook]]'' *''[[The Thrawn Trilogy Sourcebook]]'' *''[[Star Wars Encyclopedia]]'' *''[[Alien Encounters]]'' *''[[A Guide to the Star Wars Universe, Third Edition, Revised and Expanded]]'' *{{GamerCite|8|I, Yuuzhan Vong}} *''[[The Complete Star Wars Encyclopedia]]'' *''[[The Essential Guide to Warfare]]'' ==Notes and references== {{Reflist}} {{Interlang |de=Werften von Yaga Minor |es=Astilleros de Yaga Minor/Leyendas }} [[Category:Galactic Empire shipyards]] [[Category:Galactic Republic shipyards]] [[Category:Planetary shipyards]] [[Category:Yaga Minor locations]]
